mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as a negative 1-month change) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS shows a negative 1-month change, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal an aggressive monetary response to high inflation, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market characterized by unemployment below 3.5% and monthly job gains exceeding 200,000, strong labor conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 200k)
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 200k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts series (measured as a positive 1-month change) signals strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST shows a positive 1-month change, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (its 2017 base), it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS show positive 1-month changes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL above 300), the central bank is likely to maintain restrictive monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
